name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
tagline: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year for all landholding farmer families
brief: PM-KISAN provides guaranteed financial assistance of ₹6,000 annually to all eligible small and marginal farmer families across India, transferred directly to their bank accounts in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
financialBenefit: ₹6,000 / year (3 installments of ₹2,000)
benefits: Direct DBT transfer of ₹2,000 every four months directly into Aadhaar-linked bank accounts
No intermediaries or commission deductions; 100% transparent digital transfer
Assistance for purchasing agricultural inputs like seeds, fertilizers, and equipment

exclusions: Farmer families holding constitutional posts or serving/retired govt employees
Income tax payers from previous assessment year
Professionals like doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs
eligibilityCriteria.summary: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land parcels in their names, subject to statutory exclusion criteria (e.g., non-income tax payers).

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.detail: Must be linked with your active mobile number for e-KYC authentication.

documentsRequired.name: Land Ownership Record (Khatauni / RoR)
documentsRequired.detail: Updated land registry record proving cultivable landholding in applicant's name.

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Passbook
documentsRequired.detail: Bank account must be active, with NPCI mapping enabled for DBT transfers.

applicationSteps.title: Check Land Record & e-KYC
applicationSteps.description: Ensure your land ownership documents (Khatauni) are updated and mobile is linked to Aadhaar.

applicationSteps.title: Self-Registration on Portal
applicationSteps.description: Visit pmkisan.gov.in -> 'New Farmer Registration'. Select Rural or Urban Farmer Registration.

applicationSteps.title: Enter Aadhaar & State Details
applicationSteps.description: Provide Aadhaar number, state, district, sub-district, block, and village.

applicationSteps.title: Land & Bank Account Details
applicationSteps.description: Input land survey number, dag/khasra number, area in hectares, and bank account details.

applicationSteps.title: State Nodal Verification & Approval
applicationSteps.description: The local Patwari / Revenue Officer verifies records before installments commence.

faqs.q: Can tenant farmers or landless laborers apply for PM-KISAN?
faqs.a: No. As per current guidelines, cultivable land ownership in the applicant's name is required. Landless agricultural laborers can explore MGNREGA or PM-SYM schemes.

faqs.q: Why is my installment pending even after registration?
faqs.a: Most pending installments occur due to incomplete Aadhaar e-KYC or unlinked NPCI bank accounts. Complete OTP-based eKYC on pmkisan.gov.in or visit a CSC center.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana)
hindiName: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / National Health Authority (NHA)
tagline: Cashless health cover of ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary & tertiary hospital care
brief: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme. It provides a health cover of ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across public and empaneled private hospitals.
financialBenefit: ₹5,00,000 cashless health insurance / family / year
benefits: Cashless and paperless access to healthcare services at empaneled hospitals across India
Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses
Over 1,949 medical and surgical procedures covered with zero out-of-pocket expenditure
Includes coverage for all citizens aged 70 and above irrespective of income under Ayushman Vay Vandana

exclusions: Government employees and pensioners with CGHS/ECHS cover
Families with higher tax brackets not listed in SECC 2011 or NFSA lists
eligibilityCriteria.summary: Families listed in SECC 2011 deprivation criteria, active NFSA Ration Card holders, and all senior citizens aged 70+ irrespective of income.

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.detail: For biometric or OTP identification of each family member.

documentsRequired.name: Ration Card (NFSA) / Family ID
documentsRequired.detail: Ration Card establishing relationship with the head of the family.

documentsRequired.name: Active Mobile Number
documentsRequired.detail: For receiving Ayushman Card SMS authentication.

applicationSteps.title: Check Beneficiary Status
applicationSteps.description: Go to beneficiary.nha.gov.in and search by Mobile, Aadhaar, Family ID, or Ration Card number.

applicationSteps.title: Self e-KYC Verification
applicationSteps.description: Authenticate identity through Aadhaar OTP, IRIS, or fingerprint.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Recent Photograph
applicationSteps.description: Take a live photo via web camera or smartphone camera for verification.

applicationSteps.title: Instant Ayushman Card Generation
applicationSteps.description: Once approved, download the PVC Ayushman Golden Card for cashless hospital admissions.

faqs.q: Is there any family size or age limit?
faqs.a: No, there is no restriction on family size, age, or gender. Pre-existing conditions are covered from day one.

faqs.q: Are all senior citizens 70+ eligible?
faqs.a: Yes! Under the expanded Ayushman Bharat Vay Vandana scheme, every Indian citizen aged 70 and above is entitled to a dedicated ₹5 Lakh top-up health cover regardless of income.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U 2.0)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
tagline: Financial assistance & interest subsidy for pucca housing in urban areas
brief: PMAY-U 2.0 provides interest subsidies and direct financial assistance to Economically Weaker Section (EWS), Low Income Group (LIG), and Middle Income Group (MIG) families living in urban areas who do not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
financialBenefit: Up to ₹2,50,000 subsidy / financial assistance for home construction or purchase
benefits: Interest subsidy voucher on home loans up to ₹25 Lakhs for eligible buyers
Direct financial grant for beneficiary-led individual house construction
Mandatory inclusion of female head of household as owner or co-owner

exclusions: Beneficiary or family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India
eligibilityCriteria.summary: Urban families belonging to EWS (income up to ₹3L), LIG (₹3L-₹6L), or MIG (₹6L-₹9L) without an existing pucca house.

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Affidavit of Non-Ownership of Pucca House
Bank Account Details (Aadhaar linked)
documentsRequired.detail: Passbook copy showing IFSC and account number.

applicationSteps.title: Check Urban Body Survey
applicationSteps.description: Visit pmaymis.gov.in or your local municipal corporation / ULB helpdesk.

applicationSteps.title: Citizen Assessment Entry
applicationSteps.description: Select 'Apply Online' under PMAY-U 2.0 and verify Aadhaar.

applicationSteps.title: Provide Family & Income Data
applicationSteps.description: Fill out current residence address, income details, and preferred housing vertical.

applicationSteps.title: ULB Field Verification
applicationSteps.description: Municipal authorities conduct geo-tagging and document inspection.

faqs.q: Can single unmarried individuals apply?
faqs.a: Yes, if they meet the income criteria and do not own a pucca house anywhere in India.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
tagline: Full tuition fee waiver and maintenance allowance for post-secondary education
brief: This scheme provides financial assistance to students belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage (Classes 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, Undergraduate, and Postgraduate) to enable them to complete their education.
financialBenefit: 100% compulsory non-refundable fees + ₹13,500/year maintenance allowance
benefits: Covers full non-refundable college and university tuition fees directly to institutions
Monthly maintenance allowance deposited straight to student's bank account
Special allowances for differently-abled scholars, thesis typing, and study tours

eligibilityCriteria.summary: SC/ST students with family income ≤ ₹2.5 Lakh/annum and OBC students with family income ≤ ₹1.5 Lakh/annum pursuing recognized post-matric courses.

documentsRequired.name: Caste Certificate
documentsRequired.detail: Digitally signed caste certificate from Tehsildar / SDO.

documentsRequired.name: Income Certificate
documentsRequired.detail: Valid income certificate for current financial year.

documentsRequired.name: Fee Receipt & College Bonafide
documentsRequired.detail: Issued by head of college or university.

applicationSteps.title: Register on National Scholarship Portal
applicationSteps.description: Go to scholarships.gov.in (NSP) or respective state scholarship portal.

applicationSteps.title: Generate OTR (One Time Registration)
applicationSteps.description: Complete Face-authentication or Aadhaar biometric OTP for OTR.

applicationSteps.title: Select Scheme & Fill Application
applicationSteps.description: Fill academic history, fee details, and upload scanned documents.

applicationSteps.title: Institute & State Nodal Verification
applicationSteps.description: Your college verifies your form, followed by the District Welfare Officer approval.

faqs.q: Can students studying in private colleges apply?
faqs.a: Yes, provided the course and college are recognized by UGC, AICTE, MCI, or state government boards.

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
hindiName: पीएम स्वनिधि योजना (स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स आत्मनिर्भर निधि)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
tagline: Collateral-free working capital micro-credit from ₹10,000 up to ₹50,000 for street vendors
brief: PM SVANidhi is a flagship micro-credit scheme providing working capital loans to urban and peri-urban street vendors to restart and expand their livelihoods, with 7% interest subsidies and cash-back incentives on digital transactions.
financialBenefit: Tranche 1: ₹10,000; Tranche 2: ₹20,000; Tranche 3: ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy
benefits: Collateral-free micro-credit without needing property or guarantor
7% annual interest subsidy credited directly to your bank account on timely repayment
Cashback incentives up to ₹1,200 per year for conducting digital QR transactions
Eligibility for higher credit limits up to ₹50,000 upon timely repayment of earlier loans

eligibilityCriteria.summary: Street vendors engaged in vending in urban areas possessing a Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies, or Recommendation Letter (LoR).

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.detail: Linked with mobile number for instant loan e-sign.

documentsRequired.name: Vending Card / Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
documentsRequired.detail: Issued by municipal corporation or town vending committee.

documentsRequired.name: Bank Account Details
documentsRequired.detail: Passbook copy for direct loan disbursal.

applicationSteps.title: Check Vending Status / Apply for LoR
applicationSteps.description: Check if your name is listed on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or obtain LoR from ULB.

applicationSteps.title: Choose Lending Institution
applicationSteps.description: Select your preferred bank, NBFC, or Microfinance institution on the portal.

applicationSteps.title: Digital Application Submission
applicationSteps.description: Apply online or via Common Service Centre (CSC) without visiting branch.

applicationSteps.title: Disbursal & Digital Onboarding
applicationSteps.description: Loan is credited to bank account; bank provides BHIM / UPI QR code for cashback.

faqs.q: Do I need a CIBIL score to get the first ₹10,000 loan?
faqs.a: No, PM SVANidhi was specifically crafted for citizens without prior formal credit history.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
tagline: End-to-end holistic support for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 trades
brief: PM Vishwakarma provides recognition, skill upgradation, toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, and collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹3,00,000 at a concessional 5% interest rate to traditional artisans working with their hands and tools.
financialBenefit: ₹15,000 modern toolkit grant + up to ₹3,00,000 collateral-free loan at 5% interest
benefits: Official PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID Card recognizing traditional skill
Basic skill training (5-7 days) and Advanced training (15+ days) with ₹500/day stipend
E-voucher of ₹15,000 for modern digital toolkit procurement
Collateral-free enterprise loan: Tranche 1 of ₹1 Lakh, Tranche 2 of ₹2 Lakh at 5% interest
Digital transaction incentive of ₹1 per transaction up to 100 transactions monthly

exclusions: Govt servants and their family members; applicants who have availed PMEGP/MUDRA loans in last 5 years with outstanding dues.
eligibilityCriteria.summary: Traditional craftspeople working in one of the 18 specified trades on self-employment basis. One member per family is eligible.

documentsRequired.name: Active Mobile Number
documentsRequired.detail: Linked with Aadhaar for OTP verification.

documentsRequired.name: Bank Passbook
documentsRequired.detail: Account where ₹500/day stipend and loan will be disbursed.

documentsRequired.name: Ration Card
documentsRequired.detail: To verify single beneficiary per family criteria.

applicationSteps.title: CSC Biometric Registration
applicationSteps.description: Visit any Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and mobile.

applicationSteps.title: Gram Panchayat / ULB Verification
applicationSteps.description: Local Gram Pradhan or Executive Officer verifies your trade engagement.

applicationSteps.title: District Screening Committee Approval
applicationSteps.description: Application cleared by District Committee chaired by Collector/MSME GM.

applicationSteps.title: Skill Training & Toolkit Voucher
applicationSteps.description: Complete 5-day basic training, receive ₹15,000 toolkit voucher, and access loan.

faqs.q: Which trades are covered under PM Vishwakarma?
faqs.a: 18 traditional trades: Carpenter (Suthar), Boat Builder, Armourer, Blacksmith (Lohar), Locksmith, Hammer & Tool Kit Maker, Sculptor (Moortikar), Goldsmith (Sunar), Potter (Kumhaar), Cobbler (Charmakar), Mason (Rajmistri), Basket/Mat/Broom Weaver, Doll & Toy Maker, Barber (Naai), Garland Maker (Malakaar), Washerman (Dhobi), Tailor (Darzi), and Fishing Net Maker.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development & Ministry of Finance
tagline: High-interest, tax-free small savings scheme for the girl child's education and marriage
brief: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is a government-backed savings initiative under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao. Parents can open an account for their girl child before she turns 10, earning high sovereign guaranteed interest (currently 8.2% p.a.) with full tax exemption under Section 80C (EEE status).
financialBenefit: 8.2% annual compound interest + complete tax-free maturity amount
benefits: Highest interest rate among small savings schemes (8.2% compounded annually)
Triple tax exemption (EEE) - deposit amount, interest earned, and maturity are 100% tax-free
Flexible deposit from minimum ₹250 to maximum ₹1,50,000 per financial year
Partial withdrawal up to 50% allowed when the girl turns 18 for higher education

eligibilityCriteria.summary: Girl child who is an Indian resident and aged below 10 years at account opening. Maximum 2 accounts per family (or 3 in case of twin girls).

documentsRequired.name: Birth Certificate of Girl Child
documentsRequired.detail: Issued by municipal corporation or registrar of births.

documentsRequired.name: Identity Proof of Guardian (Aadhaar / PAN)
documentsRequired.detail: Parent or legal guardian's ID proof.

applicationSteps.title: Download Account Opening Form
applicationSteps.description: Obtain Form-1 from nearest Post Office or authorized commercial bank (SBI, PNB, etc.).

applicationSteps.title: Submit Documents & Initial Deposit
applicationSteps.description: Submit birth certificate and KYC with initial deposit (min ₹250).

applicationSteps.title: Receive SSY Passbook
applicationSteps.description: The post office or bank issues a passbook recording deposits and interest accrued.

faqs.q: When does the account mature?
faqs.a: The account matures after 21 years from the date of opening or upon the girl's marriage after attaining 18 years of age. Deposits need to be made only for 15 years.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY 2.0)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
tagline: Direct maternity benefit cash incentive of ₹5,000 to ₹6,000 for pregnant women
brief: PMMVY provides cash incentives transferred directly to bank accounts of pregnant women and lactating mothers for wage compensation during childbirth, enabling adequate rest and maternal and child nutritional support.
financialBenefit: ₹5,000 for first child (2 installments) and ₹6,000 for second child if girl child
benefits: Financial compensation directly to mother's Aadhaar-linked bank account
Encourages institutional deliveries and full immunization of infant
Special higher incentive of ₹6,000 for the birth of a second girl child to counter female foeticide

exclusions: Women employed in Central or State Govt or PSUs receiving paid maternity leave.
eligibilityCriteria.summary: Pregnant women and lactating mothers belonging to socially/economically disadvantaged sections having their first or second child.

documentsRequired.name: Mother Child Protection (MCP) Card
documentsRequired.detail: Issued by Anganwadi / ANM recording LMP and antenatal checkups.

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card of Mother
documentsRequired.detail: Must be seeded with bank account.

documentsRequired.name: Eligibility Proof Document
documentsRequired.detail: Ration Card (NFSA) / E-Shram / PM-JAY Card / MNREGA Job Card.

applicationSteps.title: Register at Anganwadi / Online Portal
applicationSteps.description: Register within 570 days of LMP at Anganwadi Centre or on pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.

applicationSteps.title: Submit Installment 1 Claim
applicationSteps.description: Claim ₹3,000 upon pregnancy registration and at least one ANC checkup.

applicationSteps.title: Submit Installment 2 Claim
applicationSteps.description: Claim ₹2,000 upon institutional birth and first cycle of child vaccination.

faqs.q: Can mother apply online from home?
faqs.a: Yes! The PMMVY Citizen Portal allows self-registration by the mother using her Aadhaar and mobile OTP.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Department of Financial Services
tagline: Collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹20 Lakhs for micro and small entrepreneurs
brief: MUDRA enables micro and small enterprises to access collateral-free institutional credit across four categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakhs), Tarun (₹5 Lakhs to ₹10 Lakhs), and the enhanced Tarun Plus (up to ₹20 Lakhs).
financialBenefit: Loans from ₹50,000 up to ₹20,00,000 without requiring collateral or third-party guarantee
benefits: Zero collateral or property pledge required for business loans
Low processing fees and competitive interest rates pegged to bank MCLR
Mudra Debit Card provided for convenient working capital withdrawal
Expanded limit up to ₹20 Lakhs for entrepreneurs with sound repayment track records

exclusions: Corporate entities, agricultural activities (except allied agri activities)
eligibilityCriteria.summary: Any Indian citizen with a non-farm business proposal in manufacturing, trading, or service sectors.

documentsRequired.name: Proof of Identity & Address
documentsRequired.detail: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or Driving License.

documentsRequired.name: Business Proof / Registration
documentsRequired.detail: Udyam Registration, GST, Trade license if established.

documentsRequired.name: Project Proposal / Quotation
documentsRequired.detail: Quotation of machinery/goods to be purchased.

applicationSteps.title: Prepare Project Plan
applicationSteps.description: Formulate a simple cost estimate for equipment, inventory, and working capital.

applicationSteps.title: Apply via Udyamimitra Portal
applicationSteps.description: Visit udyamimitra.in or apply at any Commercial Bank, RRB, or Small Finance Bank branch.

applicationSteps.title: Loan Appraisal & Sanction
applicationSteps.description: Bank reviews project viability and sanctions loan under Shishu, Kishore, or Tarun.

faqs.q: Do I need a security deposit?
faqs.a: No security or collateral is required for MUDRA loans as they are covered under Credit Guarantee Fund.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / PFRDA
tagline: Guaranteed monthly lifelong pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60
brief: Atal Pension Yojana is a government-backed pension scheme focused on unorganized sector workers, providing a guaranteed monthly pension ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month upon turning 60, backed by sovereign guarantee of the Government of India.
financialBenefit: Guaranteed ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 monthly pension for life + return of corpus to nominee
benefits: Government guaranteed minimum pension regardless of market fluctuations
Pension continues to spouse upon subscriber's demise; entire pension corpus returned to nominees
Income tax deduction benefits under Section 80CCD(1B) up to ₹50,000
Extremely affordable contributions starting as low as ₹42 per month

exclusions: Citizens who are income tax payers as of 1st October 2022
eligibilityCriteria.summary: All Indian citizens between 18 and 40 years holding a savings bank account, who are not income tax payers.

applicationSteps.title: Visit Bank or Netbanking
applicationSteps.description: Login to your bank's mobile app or visit bank/post office branch.

applicationSteps.title: Fill APY Subscriber Registration Form
applicationSteps.description: Choose desired monthly pension amount (₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000).

applicationSteps.title: Set Auto-Debit Mandate
applicationSteps.description: Authorize monthly auto-debit from your savings account.

applicationSteps.title: Receive PRAN Card
applicationSteps.description: Download your Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) from nsdl.co.in.

faqs.q: What happens if subscriber dies before age 60?
faqs.a: Spouse can continue contributing for the remaining period until the subscriber would have turned 60, or opt to withdraw the accumulated corpus.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
tagline: Comprehensive crop loss insurance at a nominal premium of just 1.5% to 2%
brief: PMFBY provides comprehensive crop insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, unseasonal rain, hailstorm, pest attack) from pre-sowing to post-harvest stages at extremely low premium rates for farmers.
financialBenefit: 100% compensation of insured crop sum at only 1.5% - 2% farmer premium share
benefits: Maximum 2% premium for Kharif crops and 1.5% for Rabi crops; balance paid by Government
Immediate localized calamity relief and mid-season adversity payout
Post-harvest loss coverage for up to 14 days against cyclone and unseasonal rains
Drone and satellite-based transparent crop loss assessment

eligibilityCriteria.summary: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.

documentsRequired.name: Sowing Certificate
documentsRequired.detail: Issued by Patwari / Village Agriculture Assistant.

documentsRequired.name: Bank Passbook
documentsRequired.detail: Account where claim amount will be credited.

applicationSteps.title: Check Cutoff Date for Season
applicationSteps.description: Ensure applying before Kharif (31st July) or Rabi (31st December) deadline.

applicationSteps.title: Apply via Portal / Bank / CSC
applicationSteps.description: Apply on pmfby.gov.in, Kisan Call Centre, or local bank.

applicationSteps.title: Report Damage within 72 Hours
applicationSteps.description: In case of crop loss, report within 72 hours via Crop Insurance App or toll-free number.

faqs.q: How quickly should crop loss be reported?
faqs.a: Must be reported within 72 hours of localized calamity like hailstorm or waterlogging on the Crop Insurance App.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
tagline: Free industry-relevant skill training, recognized NSQF certification, and job placement support
brief: PMKVY 4.0 offers outcome-based skill training in cutting-edge modern domains including Industry 4.0, AI, Robotics, Mechatronics, Green Hydrogen, Drone technology, and traditional service sectors with 100% free courses and monetary certification rewards.
financialBenefit: 100% free skill training + assessment fees paid by Govt + monetary certification rewards
benefits: Industry-aligned NSQF Level 3-7 certifications recognized across India and overseas
On-the-job training (OJT) and apprenticeship linkages with top corporate employers
Free travel allowance and boarding assistance for rural candidates
Special focus on future skills: Drone piloting, EV servicing, AI data labeling, Solar PV install

eligibilityCriteria.summary: Any Indian youth who is a school/college dropout or unemployed looking to gain job-ready industrial skills.

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.detail: Mandatory for Skill India Digital biometric attendance.

documentsRequired.name: Educational Certificates
documentsRequired.detail: Mark sheet of highest qualification attained.

applicationSteps.title: Register on Skill India Digital Hub
applicationSteps.description: Go to skillindiadigital.gov.in and create your learner profile.

applicationSteps.title: Search Courses & Centers Nearby
applicationSteps.description: Search by job role, sector, or district (e.g. Drone Pilot, Solar Technician).

applicationSteps.title: Enroll & Attend Training
applicationSteps.description: Attend free practical and theoretical training at authorized Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK).

applicationSteps.title: Assessment & Rozgar Mela
applicationSteps.description: Pass Sector Skill Council assessment to receive digital certificate and attend campus job fairs.

faqs.q: Are there any fees for courses?
faqs.a: No, PMKVY training and assessment are 100% free for eligible candidates.

name: Lakhpati Didi Initiative
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development (DAY-NRLM)
tagline: Empowering women Self-Help Group (SHG) members to earn sustainable income ≥ ₹1 Lakh per year
brief: The Lakhpati Didi initiative is an ambitious program enabling rural women associated with Self-Help Groups (SHGs) to achieve a sustainable annual income of at least ₹1,00,000 through micro-enterprise, market linkage, Drone Didi training, organic farming, and interest-subvention loans.
financialBenefit: Subsidized enterprise credit up to ₹5,00,000 + access to drone tech / enterprise equipment
benefits: Dedicated entrepreneurship training, financial literacy, and digital commerce onboarding
Access to community investment fund and interest subvention loans through Bank SHG linkages
Namo Drone Didi training: Free drone pilot certification and agricultural drone equipment for rental
Direct integration with GeM (Government e-Marketplace) and Amazon Saheli for selling goods

eligibilityCriteria.summary: Active women members of registered Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) Self-Help Groups.

documentsRequired.name: SHG Membership Passbook / ID
documentsRequired.detail: Issued by Village Organization (VO) / Cluster Level Federation (CLF).

applicationSteps.title: Join or Verify SHG Membership
applicationSteps.description: Ensure active membership in a village Self-Help Group under DAY-NRLM.

applicationSteps.title: Prepare Livelihood Action Plan
applicationSteps.description: Formulate enterprise proposal with Community Resource Person (CRP).

applicationSteps.title: Skill Training & Credit Linkage
applicationSteps.description: Undergo technical training and receive enterprise capital through SHG bank linkage.

faqs.q: What is a Namo Drone Didi?
faqs.a: A specialized track under Lakhpati Didi where selected SHG women receive drone pilot licenses and drones to provide pesticide and fertilizer spraying services to local farmers, earning ₹15,000-₹30,000/month.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
hindiName: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
tagline: Guaranteed legal entitlement of 100 days wage employment in rural areas
brief: MGNREGA provides legal guarantee of at least 100 days of unskilled manual wage employment in every financial year to adult members of any rural household willing to do manual work, with statutory minimum wage paid directly to bank accounts.
financialBenefit: 100 days guaranteed wage employment (wages range ₹234 to ₹374/day by state) via direct DBT
benefits: Legal right to work within 15 days of application, else unemployment allowance is payable
Work provided within 5 km radius of applicant's village; travel allowance paid if beyond 5 km
Wages transferred directly to Aadhaar-Based Payment System (ABPS) bank accounts within 15 days
Creche facilities, drinking water, and first aid provided at worksite

eligibilityCriteria.summary: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual public works.

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.detail: Required for ABPS biometric wage crediting.

applicationSteps.title: Submit Job Card Application
applicationSteps.description: Submit application to Gram Panchayat office or online on nrega.nic.in.

applicationSteps.title: Gram Panchayat Verification
applicationSteps.description: Verification of age and local residence; Job Card issued within 15 days.

applicationSteps.title: Demand Work (Rozgar Maang)
applicationSteps.description: Submit dated written demand for work; Panchayat must allocate work within 15 days.

faqs.q: What happens if work is not provided within 15 days?
faqs.a: The state government is legally bound to pay an unemployment allowance directly to your bank account.

name: ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / DEPwD
tagline: Free modern assistive aids, motorized tricycles, braille kits, and cochlear implants
brief: The ADIP scheme assists persons with disabilities by providing durable, sophisticated, and scientifically manufactured modern aids and appliances including motorized tricycles, wheelchairs, hearing aids, braille readers, and cochlear implants to promote independence and physical rehabilitation.
financialBenefit: Free aids and appliances worth up to ₹10,000 - ₹50,000 (and up to ₹6,00,000 for Cochlear Implants)
benefits: 100% free aids and appliances for beneficiaries with family income up to ₹22,500/month
Motorized tricycles (battery operated) for persons with 80%+ locomotor disability
Daisy players, laptops with screen reading software, and braille slates for visually impaired
Free surgical fitment and speech therapy for cochlear implants for deaf children up to 5 years

eligibilityCriteria.summary: Indian citizen with 40% or more certified disability holding a valid UDID Card / Disability Certificate with family income ≤ ₹30,000/month.

documentsRequired.name: UDID Card / Disability Certificate
documentsRequired.detail: Showing 40% or more disability issued by Chief Medical Officer (CMO).

applicationSteps.title: Register on ALIMCO / ADIP Portal
applicationSteps.description: Visit adip.disabilityaffairs.gov.in or attend local ALIMCO assessment camp.

applicationSteps.title: Upload UDID Card & Prescriptions
applicationSteps.description: Upload disability details and doctor's recommendation for specific assistive aid.

applicationSteps.title: Receive Aid at Samajik Adhikarita Shivir
applicationSteps.description: Assistive devices are fitted and distributed at free district distribution camps.

faqs.q: How frequently can an assistive device be re-applied for?
faqs.a: Aids and appliances can be replaced after 3 years for adult beneficiaries and after 1 year for children below 12 years.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
tagline: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakh to ₹1.30 Lakh for building pucca houses in rural areas
brief: PMAY-G helps rural homeless families and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses to construct a hygienic pucca house equipped with clean cooking facility, electricity, and toilet via convergence with Swachh Bharat Mission.
financialBenefit: ₹1,20,000 (Plains) / ₹1,30,000 (Hilly/NE/IAP areas) + 90 days MGNREGA wages (approx ₹20,000)
benefits: Direct fund release into beneficiary bank accounts in 3 installments linked to construction stages
Additional ₹12,000 assistance for building an attached toilet under Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM-G)
90 to 95 days of unskilled labor wages under MGNREGA paid directly to house owner
LPG connection provided via PM Ujjwala Yojana upon house completion

exclusions: Households owning 2/3/4 wheeler, mechanized 3/4 wheeler agricultural equipment, credit limit of ₹50,000+ kisan credit card, govt employees.
eligibilityCriteria.summary: Deprived rural households living in zero, one, or two-room kutcha houses identified through Awaas+ survey and Gram Sabha prioritization.

documentsRequired.name: MGNREGA Job Card
documentsRequired.detail: For disbursing 90 days construction wage entitlement.

applicationSteps.title: Check Gram Sabha Priority List
applicationSteps.description: Verify your family name in the Awaas+ permanent waitlist at your Gram Panchayat or on pmayg.nic.in.

applicationSteps.title: Geo-Tagging of Old Kutcha House
applicationSteps.description: Gram Rozgar Sahayak takes geo-tagged photos of current dilapidated house via AwaasApp.

applicationSteps.title: Stage-wise Construction & Payments
applicationSteps.description: Installment 1 released at foundation, Installment 2 at lintel level, Installment 3 on completion.

faqs.q: Do I need to pay any officer or middleman?
faqs.a: Never! PMAY-G payments are 100% DBT credited straight into your bank account. Geo-tagging is free.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Uttar Pradesh
tagline: Financial assistance of ₹25,000 in six installments for the birth and education of girls
brief: The UP Government provides financial assistance of ₹25,000 divided into 6 milestone installments starting from birth to graduation, promoting the education and health of daughters in Uttar Pradesh.
financialBenefit: ₹25,000 in 6 conditional milestones via DBT
benefits: Milestone 1: ₹5,000 upon birth of girl child
Milestone 2: ₹2,000 on completion of full immunization within 1 year
Milestone 3: ₹3,000 on admission in Class 1
Milestone 4: ₹3,000 on admission in Class 6
Milestone 5: ₹5,000 on admission in Class 9
Milestone 6: ₹7,000 on passing 10th/12th and enrolling in Degree/Diploma

eligibilityCriteria.summary: Permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh with annual family income up to ₹3,00,000. Maximum two daughters per family.

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card of Parent & Girl Child
Bank Passbook of Mother / Girl Child

applicationSteps.title: Register on MKSY Portal
applicationSteps.description: Go to mksy.up.gov.in -> 'Citizen Service Portal'.

applicationSteps.title: Apply for Applicable Milestone
applicationSteps.description: Select stage (Birth, Immunization, Class 1, 6, 9, or Higher Education) and upload documents.

applicationSteps.title: BDO / SDM / DPO Verification
applicationSteps.description: District Probation Officer verifies application and DBT credits to bank.

faqs.q: How many daughters in a family can benefit?
faqs.a: Up to two daughters per family, or up to three if the second birth results in twin girls.

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
tagline: Monthly direct financial assistance of ₹1,250 (₹15,000/year) to women in MP
brief: Ladli Behna provides monthly direct financial assistance of ₹1,250 to married, widowed, divorced, and abandoned women in Madhya Pradesh to foster economic independence, nutritional health, and self-reliance.
financialBenefit: ₹1,250 / month (₹15,000 / year) directly via Aadhaar DBT
benefits: Direct deposit on the 10th of every month into Aadhaar-linked DBT bank account
No paper forms needed; biometric e-KYC assisted at Gram Panchayat camps
Supplementary support alongside PMMVY and Lakhpati Didi benefits

exclusions: Income tax paying families, or families owning 5+ acres of cultivable land or four-wheelers.
eligibilityCriteria.summary: Resident women of MP aged 21 to 60 whose family annual income is under ₹2.5 Lakhs.

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar-Linked Bank Account with DBT Enabled
documentsRequired.detail: Must be individual savings account with active DBT mandate.

applicationSteps.title: Complete Samagra e-KYC
applicationSteps.description: Ensure your Aadhaar is linked to your Samagra ID at samagra.gov.in.

applicationSteps.title: Apply at Panchayat / Ward Camp
applicationSteps.description: Visit Gram Panchayat / Ward helpdesk with Samagra ID and Aadhaar.

applicationSteps.title: Monthly ₹1,250 DBT Credit
applicationSteps.description: DBT transfers credit on 10th of every month.

faqs.q: Are unmarried women eligible?
faqs.a: Currently, married, widowed, divorced, or deserted women between 21 and 60 years are eligible.

name: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme (MNSSBY)
ministry: Education Department & Bihar State Higher Education Council
tagline: Education loan up to ₹4 Lakhs at just 1% to 4% interest for higher education
brief: Part of Bihar's 7 Nischay initiative, this scheme provides education loans up to ₹4,00,000 at low concessional interest (1% for women, Divyangjan, and transgender; 4% for male students) guaranteed by the State Government for pursuing degree, engineering, medical, management, and diploma courses.
financialBenefit: Collateral-free loan up to ₹4,00,000 guaranteed by Government of Bihar
benefits: Zero collateral or mortgage needed; State Government acts as full guarantor
Covers tuition fees, hostel, books, laptop, and food expenses
Moratorium period: Loan repayment begins only 1 year after course completion or upon securing employment
Concessional 1% interest rate for female and Divyangjan students

eligibilityCriteria.summary: 12th pass students who are permanent residents of Bihar enrolled in recognized higher education institutions.

applicationSteps.title: Register on MNSSBY Portal
applicationSteps.description: Go to 7nischay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in.

applicationSteps.title: Visit District Registration & Counseling Centre (DRCC)
applicationSteps.description: Attend DRCC with original documents for biometric verification.

applicationSteps.title: State Approval & Direct College Disbursal
applicationSteps.description: Funds disbursed semester-wise directly to institution account.

faqs.q: Can students studying outside Bihar apply?
faqs.a: Yes! Courses in any recognized institution across India accredited by NAAC/NIRF are eligible.

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka)
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
tagline: Direct financial aid of ₹2,000 per month (₹24,000/year) to the woman head of family
brief: Gruha Lakshmi is one of Karnataka's flagship guarantee schemes, transferring ₹2,000 every month directly to the bank account of the designated woman head of household in eligible Antyodaya (AAY), BPL, and APL ration card families.
financialBenefit: ₹2,000 / month (₹24,000 / year) direct benefit transfer
benefits: Guaranteed unconditional monthly cash assistance of ₹2,000 directly to women heads of families
Promotes gender empowerment and household financial security
Hassle-free SMS appointment scheduling at Karnataka-One / Grama-One centres

exclusions: Women or husbands who are income tax payers or GST payers.
eligibilityCriteria.summary: Woman designated as head of the family on Antyodaya, BPL, or APL ration cards in Karnataka.

documentsRequired.name: Karnataka Ration Card (BPL / APL / Antyodaya)
documentsRequired.detail: Applicant must be listed as head of family.

applicationSteps.title: Check Ration Card Head Status
applicationSteps.description: Verify woman is registered as head of family on Ahara portal.

applicationSteps.title: Submit at Grama One / Karnataka One / Bangalore One
applicationSteps.description: Free registration with Aadhaar and Ration Card.

applicationSteps.title: Monthly DBT Disbursal
applicationSteps.description: ₹2,000 credited automatically to Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

faqs.q: Are APL cardholders eligible?
faqs.a: Yes, both BPL and APL cardholders qualify, as long as the woman or her spouse does not pay income tax or file GST.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
tagline: Direct monthly assistance of ₹1,500 (₹18,000/year) to women in Maharashtra
brief: Under this flagship Maharashtra initiative, eligible women aged 21 to 65 years receive ₹1,500 every month via Direct Benefit Transfer to enhance their health, nutrition, and financial independence.
financialBenefit: ₹1,500 / month (₹18,000 / year) DBT financial assistance
benefits: ₹1,500 deposited every month directly to beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account
Available to married, unmarried, widowed, divorced, and destitute women
Fast-track processing through Nari Shakti Doot App and Setu Suvidha Kendras

exclusions: Families with income tax payers or owning 4-wheelers (excluding tractors).
eligibilityCriteria.summary: Resident women of Maharashtra aged 21 to 65 with family annual income ≤ ₹2.5 Lakhs.

documentsRequired.name: Maharashtra Domicile / Ration Card (prior to 15 years)
Income Certificate
documentsRequired.detail: Annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakhs.

applicationSteps.title: Apply via Portal / Nari Shakti Doot App
applicationSteps.description: Download app or visit ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in.

applicationSteps.title: Upload Domicile & Income Details
applicationSteps.description: Fill personal and bank details and submit Aadhaar e-KYC.

applicationSteps.title: Ward / Gram Panchayat Scrutiny
applicationSteps.description: Approval granted within 15 days; monthly installments commence.

faqs.q: Are unmarried women eligible in Maharashtra?
faqs.a: Yes! Unmarried women aged 21 to 65 fulfilling the income and domicile conditions are fully eligible.
